role_in_parent: Move from the raw residue order to the best possible ordering of the same residue multiset.
statement_nl: Let n>1. If b_1,...,b_{n-1} are nonnegative real numbers, and u_1,...,u_{n-1} is a nonincreasing reordering of the same multiset of numbers, then sum_{k=1}^{n-1} b_k/k <= sum_{k=1}^{n-1} u_k/k. If equality holds, then the original list b_1,...,b_{n-1} is already nonincreasing.

domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n greater than 1
b_k are nonnegative real numbers for each k in 1 to n-1
u is obtained by reordering b, so u_1 to u_(n-1) has the same multiset of values as b_1 to b_(n-1)
u is nonincreasing, meaning u_k >= u_(k+1) for all k in 1 to n-2
weights 1/k are used in the sums for k in 1 to n-1
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every integer n greater than 1 and every nonnegative real sequence b_1,...,b_(n-1), let u_1,...,u_(n-1) be any nonincreasing reordering of the same multiset of values. Then the weighted sum of b with weights 1 over k is at most the weighted sum of u with the same weights: sum over k from 1 to n-1 of b_k divided by k is <= sum over k from 1 to n-1 of u_k divided by k. Moreover, if equality holds for this comparison, then the original sequence b_1,...,b_(n-1) is itself nonincreasing (b_1 >= b_2 >= ... >= b_(n-1)).
quantifier_order: For all integers n with n greater than 1
For all sequences b_1 to b_(n-1) of nonnegative real numbers
For all sequences u_1 to u_(n-1) that are a permutation of the multiset of b values and satisfy u_1 >= u_2 >= ... >= u_(n-1)

variables.name: n
variables.role: sequence length parameter; inequality is over indices k = 1 to n-1

variables.name: k
variables.role: index in the sums, restricted by 1 <= k <= n-1

variables.name: b
variables.role: original list (b_1,...,b_{n-1}) whose weighted sum uses weights 1/k

variables.name: u
variables.role: nonincreasing reordering (u_1,...,u_{n-1}) of the same multiset as b, used on the right-hand side

witness_dependencies: u depends on b: u is a reordering (permutation) of the multiset of values of b
the conditional conclusion about b (nonincreasing property) depends on the truth of the equality of the two weighted sums for the chosen u
